business_summary: Temairazu, Inc. engages in the development, operation, and provision of a comparison website in Japan. It operates through two segments: Application Services Business and Internet Media Business. The company offers TEMAIRAZU, an online system that allows customers to centrally manage various accommodation reservation sites; Compare.com, offers products and services in a wide range of fields, including shopping, providers, travel, and asset management; and Hikaku.com, a site that compares the prices of various e-commerce sites. The company also provides services, such as requests for information and estimates, applications, reservations, and purchasing agency services. Temairazu, Inc. was formerly known as Hikaku.com Corporation and changed its name to Temairazu, Inc. in October 2017. The company was incorporated in 2003 and is based in Tokyo, Japan.
